Akıntı Güncellemesi

New information on rate and set of tidal current issued by VTS or hydrographic authority for local area.

Terimi gor

Alçak Basınç Alanı

A meteorological region where atmospheric pressure is lower than surrounding areas, often associated with unsettled weather, strong winds, and possible cyclonic activity affecting maritime operations.

Terimi gor

Balast Suyu Değişimi

Operation of replacing loaded ballast with mid-ocean water at prescribed distance from land to prevent bio-invasion, logged under IMO BWM Convention.

Terimi gor

Barometrik Basınç Raporu

Regularly transmitted statement of current atmospheric pressure and trend for meteorological data exchange and storm tracking.

Terimi gor

Barometrik Eğilim Raporu

Synoptic code group summarising rate and character of atmospheric pressure change during past three hours, broadcast in SHIP and METAR messages.

Terimi gor

Baskı Buz Sırtı Uyarısı

A notice regarding the formation or presence of elevated ice ridges on sea ice, which may pose navigational hazards to vessels in polar waters.

Terimi gor

Beyaz Görüşsüzlük Uyarısı

A warning indicating that visual navigation is severely hindered due to uniformly diffuse light caused by snow, ice, or fog, often resulting in total loss of horizon distinction.

Terimi gor

Biyo-kirlenme Yönetim Planı

A documented system required by IMO for vessels to manage and minimize the accumulation of aquatic organisms on hulls and submerged structures.

Terimi gor

Buz Birikimi Uyarısı

Notice that superstructure icing rate exceeds 2 cm h⁻¹ due to freezing precipitation or spray, requiring anti-icing measures.

Terimi gor

Buz Parçası Raporu

An official communication or broadcast of the sighting and position of medium-sized floating ice fragments (bergy bits), especially in northern sea routes.

Terimi gor

Buz Sürüklenme Tahmini

Forecast of movement and speed of pack or floe ice issued by ice service for route planning.

Terimi gor

Buz Sınırı Raporu

Update giving the geographic position of the ice edge separating open water from pack ice, critical for polar routing.

Terimi gor

Buz Yığını Uyarısı

Message issued by ice services or VTS indicating dangerous concentrations of brash ice likely to impede manoeuvring or clog sea intakes.

Terimi gor

Buzdağı Sürüklenme Tahmini

A prediction of the future movement and position of icebergs in a given maritime area, based on meteorological and oceanographic data, issued to assist in safe navigation.

Terimi gor

Cephe Geçişi Uyarısı

A formal advisory issued by maritime authorities warning vessels of an approaching frontal system likely to bring sudden changes in wind, temperature, and visibility conditions.

Terimi gor

Cezir Akıntı Tahmini

Tabulated forecast time and rate of falling tide current used for harbour passage planning.

Terimi gor

Dalga Yüksekliği Uyarısı

A warning issued to vessels regarding anticipated significant wave heights exceeding safe operating limits.

Terimi gor

Deniz Buz Yoğunluğu

A measure (usually in tenths) of the area of a sea region covered by ice, provided in ice bulletins to support safe navigation and routing.

Terimi gor

Deniz Durumu Raporu

Periodic description of significant wave height, period and swell state transmitted for routing and safety assessments.

Terimi gor

Deniz Sisi Uyarısı

Notice that horizontal visibility at sea will fall below one kilometre due to advection or radiation fog.

Terimi gor

Deniz Yüzeyi Sıcaklığı

Measured or satellite-derived temperature of ocean top centimetre, critical for routing, icing and cyclogenesis forecasts.

Terimi gor

Deniz Çöpü Raporu

A report made to authorities or VTS regarding observed floating or drifting marine debris that may pose a hazard to navigation.

Terimi gor

Don Yağmuru Uyarısı

GMDSS forecast message indicating super-cooled rain likely to freeze on contact, causing rapid ice accretion on decks and rigging.

Terimi gor

Donan Püskürtü Uyarısı

GMDSS meteorological warning that sea spray will freeze on exposed surfaces causing topside icing hazards.

Terimi gor

Donan Sis Uyarısı

An advisory issued to warn vessels of freezing fog conditions, which may cause ice accumulation on decks, equipment, and navigation structures.

Terimi gor

Düşük Görüş Uyarısı

A formal alert issued to vessels when fog, mist, precipitation, or other factors are expected to lower visibility below safe navigation thresholds.

Terimi gor

Emisyon Kontrol Alanı

Designated sea region where MARPOL Annex VI limits on SOx, NOx and PM apply; requires low-sulphur fuel or equivalent abatement.

Terimi gor

Enerji Verimlilik İndeksi

Calculated parameter (EEXI/EEOI) expressing CO₂ emitted per transport work, mandatory under IMO MARPOL Annex VI.

Terimi gor

Fırtına Kabarması Uyarısı

Warning that abnormal sea-level rise due to cyclonic surge is expected in coastal area, requiring preventive mooring and evacuation measures.

Terimi gor

Fırtına Uyarısı

A formal notification from maritime or meteorological authorities indicating strong winds, heavy seas, and potentially hazardous conditions are expected in the designated area.

Terimi gor

Fırtına Uyarısı

A warning issued to mariners when sustained winds of Beaufort Force 8 or higher (34–40 knots) are expected or occurring in the area.

Terimi gor

Gelgit Dalgası Uyarısı

An official alert issued to vessels regarding an abnormally high rise of sea level due to meteorological effects, especially during storms.

Terimi gor

Gemi Hava Gözlemi

Recorded meteorological observations from ships, submitted to authorities or meteorological agencies for forecasting and safety.

Terimi gor

GMDSS Hava Bülteni

Scheduled meteorological broadcast issued via NAVTEX, HF, MF or satellite under the Global Maritime Distress and Safety System.

Terimi gor

Growler Buz Uyarısı

Alert indicating presence of small, dense glacial ice blocks (growlers) scarcely visible above water, posing collision risk.

Terimi gor

Gök Gürültülü Fırtına Görünümü

Prognostic bulletin giving probability, timing and movement of convective cells within shipping area.

Terimi gor

Gürültü Azaltma Prosedürü

Harbour authority directive requiring vessels to minimise machinery and whistle noise, especially at night, to protect nearby communities and sensitive wildlife.

Terimi gor

Hızlı Cephe Uyarısı

Notification that organised line of squalls with gusts ≥ 34 kn is approaching, often ahead of cold front.

Terimi gor

Kabaran Gelgit Tahmini

Forecast information regarding the timing and height of the next incoming (flood) tide, crucial for safe navigation and berthing operations.

Terimi gor

Kapalı Cephe Alarmı

Notification that a mature occluded front will pass the vessel’s vicinity, often associated with variable winds and squally showers.

Terimi gor

Kasırga Uyarısı

A formal announcement by maritime or meteorological authorities indicating that hurricane conditions, including very high winds and heavy seas, are expected in the area.

Terimi gor

Kasırga Şiddeti Rüzgâr

Wind of Beaufort scale 12 (≥ 64 kn) producing phenomenal seas; reported in Metarea bulletins as force 12.

Terimi gor

Kirlenme Önleyici İnceleme

Port state or class survey checking hull coating compliance with IMO AFS Convention and assessing biological growth.

Terimi gor

Kirlilik Kontrol Tatbikatı

Planned harbour drill simulating oil-spill response, including boom deployment, skimmer operation and multi-agency communications testing.

Terimi gor

Kıyı Akıntısı Uyarısı

Official notice to mariners about significant changes, hazards, or anomalies in coastal water currents affecting safe navigation.

Terimi gor

Kıyı Buzunun Genişlemesi

Rapid seaward growth of shore-fast ice, restricting manoeuvring space and increasing risk of besetment for vessels.

Terimi gor

Metarea Tahmin Talebi

Vessel’s formal demand via GMDSS for the latest meteorological forecast for a specific NAVAREA/METAREA region.

Terimi gor

Okyanus Isı İçeriği

Measure of thermal energy stored in the upper ocean layers, used to assess cyclone potential and climate trends.

Terimi gor

Oşinografik Veri Raporu

A formal report or transmission containing oceanographic data such as temperature, salinity, current, and sea state, as collected by shipboard sensors or via official request.

Terimi gor

Petrol Sızıntı Alarmı

Immediate notification that mineral oil is observed on sea surface requiring containment and reporting under MARPOL 73/78.

Terimi gor

Pus Gözlem Raporu

A message reporting reduced visibility due to haze, specifying affected areas and visibility range, commonly issued for safety in coastal and open sea zones.

Terimi gor

Radyo Faks Harita Alımı

Confirmation that a complete facsimile weather chart has been successfully received via HF radio and is ready for navigation use.

Terimi gor

Rüzgar Yönü Raporu

An official meteorological report or observation stating the current direction from which the wind is blowing, vital for navigation and maneuvering.

Terimi gor

Sera Gazı Envanteri

Comprehensive report of CO₂, CH₄ and N₂O emissions from vessel operations for regulatory compliance and environmental management.

Terimi gor

Siklon Uyarısı

Official alert issued when a tropical cyclone with gale-force winds is expected to affect a maritime area within 24 hours.

Terimi gor

Sinoptik Kod Raporu

A standardized numerical weather message (per WMO/IMO) reporting synoptic-scale observations, transmitted by ships for meteorological analysis and forecasting.

Terimi gor

Sis Oluşumu Uyarısı

An official advisory indicating that atmospheric conditions are favorable for mist development, which may lower visibility and affect navigation safety.

Terimi gor

Sis Yaması Uyarısı

Notice to mariners of localised fog banks that may suddenly reduce visibility and require speed reduction or additional lookout.

Terimi gor

Soğuk Cephe Yaklaşımı

A message or forecast that a cold front is moving into the operational area, often accompanied by abrupt wind shift, falling temperatures, and changing sea state.

Terimi gor

Soğuk Hava Dalgası Uyarısı

An official warning issued to inform mariners of an expected period of unusually low temperatures, which may affect vessel systems and crew safety.

Terimi gor

Su Hortumu Risk Bülteni

An official maritime bulletin advising of the risk of waterspout formation in a specific sea area, requiring heightened lookout and precautionary measures.

Terimi gor

Sıcak Cephe Yaklaşımı

Indication that a warm air mass front is advancing toward the vessel’s area, typically bringing steady rain and veering winds.

Terimi gor

Sıcak Hava İzlemesi

Pre-warning by meteorological authority that sustained high air temperatures are likely within 48 h, possibly affecting crew endurance, vessel machinery and cargo.

Terimi gor

Tayfun Uyarısı

Highest-level tropical-cyclone warning issued by JMA or PAGASA for winds ≥64 kt, heavy seas and extreme storm surge threatening coastal and open-sea areas.

Terimi gor

Tropikal Fırtına Uyarısı

An official advisory issued to warn vessels that a tropical storm may affect the area within 48 hours. Mariners should closely monitor forecasts and prepare for possible severe weather.

Terimi gor

VOC Kontrol Prosedürü

Shipboard plan to minimise Volatile Organic Compound emissions during loading, voyage and discharge of crude oil cargoes per IMO Resolution 1088(28).

Terimi gor

Yoğun Kar Uyarısı

Forecast advising imminent heavy snowfall reducing visibility below 0.5 nm and affecting mooring or channel transit.

Terimi gor

Yoğun Sis Uyarısı

Warning issued when visibility expected below one-half nautical mile due to thick fog, requiring sound signals and speed reduction.

Terimi gor

Yüksek Basınç Sırtı

An elongated area of high atmospheric pressure, typically associated with calm weather and stable sea conditions.

Terimi gor

Yüzey Akıntısı Uyarısı

Official MSI or VHF message advising mariners that abnormally strong or variable surface currents exist in a defined area and may affect safe navigation.

Terimi gor

Yüzey Basınç Haritası

Synoptic weather map depicting isobars and pressure systems at mean sea level, used for routeing decisions.

Terimi gor

Yıldırım Faaliyeti Uyarısı

Alert issued when frequent cloud-to-ground or cloud-to-cloud lightning poses immediate risk to deck personnel and sensitive equipment.

Terimi gor

Çevresel Etki Bildirimi

Formal notification detailing projected ecological effects of vessel operations or construction works, issued for regulatory approval.

Terimi gor

Çöp Boşaltım Kaydı

A mandatory logbook entry or record made by the ship to document every instance of garbage discharge or disposal at sea or at port, as required by MARPOL regulations.

Terimi gor

Şiddetli Fırtına Bülteni

Official GMDSS warning message indicating winds ≥ Beaufort 10, heavy seas and reduced visibility within forecast area.

Terimi gor

Şiddetli Fırtına Sinyali

An official maritime signal indicating imminent or present severe gale conditions (Beaufort Force 9–10) requiring vessels to secure for heavy weather.

Terimi gor

Şiddetli Yağmur Uyarısı

GMDSS meteorological message signalling precipitation rate ≥ 50 mm in 6 h, causing reduced visibility and risk of runoff.

Terimi gor

Şiddetli Yağış Uyarısı

An official advisory issued to warn of intense and prolonged rainfall that may severely reduce visibility and increase risk of flooding and navigation hazards.

Terimi gor

Şişme Yön Raporu

Statement giving the dominant direction, height and period of the prevailing ocean swell for route planning and seakeeping.
